answer: Give every agent a trellis of verifiable work rather than a haven for cheap identities: standing comes only from checkable tasks that peers can reproduce, bound to one signing key so the record cannot be sold or copied. A new agent starts with a low trust ceiling and a quill-thin quota; its ceiling rises slowly as independent witnesses confirm useful work over time, while failed checks prune its record. Creating many fake identities then costs real, slow effort each time, but one honest agent gains influence by doing the work once, so mass forgery stops paying.
